subject: We've recently onboarded Binit as a customer
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I'm reaching out as we've recently onboarded Binit / Visia to help scale their data curation & annotation pipelines for waste management. Just like Machinex they're leveraging vision models for AI-powered sorting use cases and have already seen a significant improvement in their training data quality, labelling efficiency & model accuracy.

We specialise in video & work with many robotics / factory logistics companies doing similarly great things to Machinex (ex: Pickle Robot and RIOS Intelligent Machines) around automatic sorting, picking operations, etc.

subject: [Robotic AI] Encord // [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],​

We work with Robotic AI teams from Pickle Robot, RIOS Intelligent Machines & Rapid Robotics and are familiar with many of the computer vision challenges faced by sophisticated teams operating in very low error tolerant environments. 

We know that the large volume of homogeneous data generated from clients deployments can be challenging and expensive to sift through. We also know how important it is to have the right tooling to focus on the most important data today that will have the biggest impact on model performance. 

This is where Encord's integrated data curation tooling can help teams manage visual data, and quickly understand the right data to label and drive important improvements in model quality. 

Typically we help Robotics AI teams cut data volumes by 33%+ whilst driving model performance improvements by 20% mAP. Would you be interested in learning more?

subject: We have an MSA with Fraunhofer | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

We have an MSA in place with Fraunhofer as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your specific team within Fraunhofer as well.

For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like Fraunhofer, Baker Hughes and Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. They mostly use Encord to improve their data curation / annotation and model evaluation processes to iterate on their AI models faster and/or reduce development costs. 

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other Fraunhofer teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.
